rules.note: Valid passport; applicants must not be Chinese citizens. Former residents of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan need extra citizenship papers and proof that Chinese nationality was cancelled.
Not listed in the official requirements.
Diploma(s) or certificate(s) of enrolment. Documents not in English or Chinese need a certified English translation stating the degree type (also for Latin diplomas).
Personal statement in English, 750 words or less.
Statement of Research Interest in English, up to 1,500 words, not counting citations.
Curriculum vitae in English, two pages at most.
Two academic letters in Chinese or English, from full or associate professors (or equivalent) in your intended field.
Needed unless English is your native language or your degree was taught in English. Minimums: IELTS Academic 7.0, TOEFL iBT 100, Cambridge 185. Scores must come directly from the test body.
Only if you receive an offer: a credential evaluation of your undergraduate degree (CSCSE for overseas degrees). Based on the September 2025 instructions; confirm for 2027.
